issues.detail: The Hebrew has only two names: מַתַּנְיָה (Mattaniah) and מַתְּנַי (Mattenai), followed by ויעשו (likely a verb form, possibly 'and they did/made' or a name fragment). The Chinese adds a third name '雅阿掃' (Ya'aso) which has no basis in the Hebrew text, and omits the final word ויעשו entirely.
